diagnosis: The SubmissionPolicy grade method allows any instructor to grade assignments without confirming that the instructor is formally assigned to teach the course to which the assignment belongs. A teacher in department A can assign arbitrary grades or remarks to students in an unrelated department B.
exploit_request:
POST /api/lms/submissions/5012/grade HTTP/1.1
